notes: Fineco: Portafoglio > Movimenti > Esporta > Excel (.xlsx; no CSV). Twelve banner rows above the header for a EUR account (Conto Corrente, Intestazione, Periodo, the opening and closing balance line, notes, "Risultati Ricerca"); header on row 13: Data_Operazione | Data_Valuta | Entrate | Uscite | Descrizione | Descrizione_Completa | Stato | Moneymap. Dates are date cells; Entrate positive and Uscite NEGATIVE numbers in separate columns; newest first. The banner wording (balance line "Saldo Iniziale: … - Saldo Finale: …" and the notes) follows one source (FinanceCopilot) and is approximate; older exports had "Data" and no Data_Valuta/Moneymap with 6 banner rows. Opening and closing come from the balance line; currency never stated.
